name: Stair Climber
steps: Step onto the stair climber, stand tall and touch the handrails lightly for balance.
Start the machine slowly and alternate feet, placing each whole foot securely on the next step.
Drive smoothly through your glutes and quads while keeping your core braced and torso upright.
Continue climbing at a steady, continuous pace for the target duration or distance, then slow down safely before stepping off.
tips: Avoid leaning heavily onto the handrails or hunching forward, which takes workload away from your legs.
Plant your whole foot rather than climbing strictly on your tiptoes.
